items.title: Five current comedy clips
items.style: Write five short English introductions, one per scene and in the supplied order. Use only the supplied clip subject and title context. Do not invent quotes, events or biography. Keep each scene close to fifty words and make the narration suitable for translation and voiceover.

source.source_text: The five clips are ordered as follows: Chris Tucker discussing a comedy club, Tom Papa discussing children and bad words, Jack Black discussing his son and martial arts, Jamie Foxx recalling the Comedy Store, and Chris Tucker discussing shoes and Matt Damon. Each scene must remain focused on its matching clip.

segments.source_text: Chris Tucker discusses running a comedy club with family. Write a short, playful introduction grounded only in that subject.
